transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

I get this overwhelming, out-of-proportion fear whenever I even think about driving over certain bridges or high stretches of road. It has gotten to the point where it is really starting to take over my life, so my husband and pastor gently encouraged me to come speak with someone.

When you experience this fear of driving over bridges or high stretches of road, do you also have episodes of intense fear or discomfort that reach a peak within minutes, accompanied by symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, or shortness of breath?

Yes, absolutely. If I even see a picture of that bridge or realize the GPS is routing me toward an overpass, my heart starts pounding and my hands get incredibly sweaty on the steering wheel. I also feel like I can't catch my breath right away, like something truly terrible is about to happen.

Can you tell me if these intense fear episodes, like the ones you described when thinking about bridges or high stretches of road, ever occur unexpectedly, without being triggered by the thought of driving over bridges or similar situations?

No, they never happen out of the blue or unexpectedly. I only get that awful, panicked feeling when I'm specifically thinking about, seeing, or anticipating having to drive over a bridge or a high road.
Do you experience this intense fear or avoidance behavior with any other situations or objects besides driving over bridges or high stretches of road?

No, not at all. This intense fear is strictly limited to bridges, overpasses, and high, elevated stretches of road. I don't have this kind of reaction to any other situations, animals, or objects, and driving on regular, flat roads is completely fine for me.
Have you ever experienced these intense fear episodes or panic symptoms in situations where you weren't thinking about or confronted with bridges or high stretches of road, even if it was just once?

No, never. I have absolutely never experienced that kind of panic out of the blue or in any other situation. It only ever happens when I am facing, or even just thinking about, those bridges and high roads.
